_meta.note: The sensor catalogue per farm type (DM-3), from the "Sensors by farm type" sheet (Farm-Sensors-by-Farm-Type.xlsx, hydroponics rows): each sensor's name, what it measures, whether it is a must-have, its typical range and what the reading means. Ranges are typical values for common vegetables and leafy greens; exact targets depend on the crop, so confirm with the agronomist. Which sensors each zone has fitted is in layout.json zones[].sensors (layoutSensor names that key); fittedBy CLIMATE_CONTROLLER is fitted on a site whose layout has a climate controller (layout.climate.controller), as the air is measured for the whole house. layoutSensor null: no zone can have one fitted yet (no reading in the contract), so it always shows Not connected. growingSystems says which farm type each layout growingSystem belongs to. readings: where the app finds the live value, from GET /api/zones/{zoneId} (zone.readings or zone) or GET /api/climate (climate.readings).

HYDROPONICS.name: Hydroponics (NFT, DWC, vertical): roots in nutrient water

sensors.name: pH sensor
sensors.indicates: Outside this range plants can't absorb some nutrients (nutrient lockout). High → add acid; low → add base.

sensors.name: EC / TDS sensor
sensors.measures: Strength of nutrients dissolved in the water
sensors.indicates: Low → plants underfed, add nutrients. High → salt stress and root burn, add fresh water.

sensors.name: Water temperature sensor
sensors.indicates: Too warm → less oxygen in water and root rot risk. Too cold → slow growth.

sensors.name: Water level sensor
sensors.indicates: Low → refill needed; pump may run dry.

sensors.name: Flow sensor
sensors.measures: Whether solution is circulating to the plants
sensors.typical: Steady at the system's design flow
sensors.indicates: Low or zero → pump failure or blockage; in NFT roots dry out within hours.

sensors.name: Air temperature & humidity sensor
sensors.indicates: High humidity → fungal disease. High temperature → heat stress, bolting.

sensors.name: Dissolved oxygen (DO) sensor
sensors.indicates: Low → roots suffocate, root rot risk. Must-have for deep-water (DWC) systems.

sensors.name: CO₂ sensor
sensors.indicates: Low in closed spaces → limits growth. Very high → unsafe for workers.

sensors.name: Light (PAR) sensor
sensors.measures: Light plants can use for growth
sensors.indicates: Too low → slow, stretched plants. Too high → leaf burn, more heat.

sensors.name: Leak / overflow sensor
sensors.indicates: Wet → leak or overflow; solution loss and electrical hazard.
